question: Cape Comorin, the southernmost tip of mainland India is located in which of the following states?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Tamil Nadu​**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

 
• **Kanyakumari **is located at the southern tip of the Cardamom Hills in Tamil Nadu.
 
• Cape means the land infiltrated into the sea and Comorin is the former ame of the Kanyakumari.&
